# opnsense_ids_policy (Data Source)

Policies that change the action of installed Suricata rules in bulk (**Services ▸ Intrusion Detection ▸ Policy**). Changes are applied with a rule reload.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the IDS policy.

### Read-Only

- `action` (Set of String) Only match rules whose default action is one of these: `disable`, `alert`, `drop`. Empty matches all.
- `content` (Set of String) Rule metadata to match, as `property.value`, e.g. `["signature_severity.Major"]`. Values must exist in the installed rules.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is active.
- `new_action` (String) Action given to matching rules: `default`, `alert`, `drop` or `disable`.
- `priority` (Number) Priority, higher values are applied later and win.
- `rulesets` (Set of String) UUIDs of the enabled rulesets this policy applies to, e.g. `[opnsense_ids_ruleset.x.uuid]`. Empty applies to all.
